result.title: SparseGraph-I2P: Consistency-Guided Hypothesis Selection for Efficient Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration
result.summary: Coarse-to-fine image-to-point-cloud (I2P) registration risks discarding correct but ambiguous patch pairs, while retaining more candidates repeats fine matching over overlapping patches. SparseGraph-I2P aims to improve registration recall by increasing the inlier ratio at the pose solver, using sensor or monocular depth. A Coarse Hypothesis Graph combines appearance with depth-derived first- and second-order compatibility to select a fixed budget of patch pairs. Sparse Fine Matching decodes each queried pixel once and skips pixel--point comparisons covered by an ancestor patch paired with the same point-cloud region. With sensor depth, depth-aware filtering ranks correspondences by SC2 spectral support for a single EPnP solve. With monocular depth, depth or inverse depth is calibrated from correspondence geometry before filtering. SparseGraph-I2P achieves the highest registration recall and lowest latency among the compared methods on RGB-D Scenes V2 and 7-Scenes with sensor depth. With predicted depth, it retains the highest recall on RGB-D Scenes V2 at an additional calibration cost. Code will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究图像到点云配准，提出用外观与深度兼容性构建粗糙假设图，在固定预算下筛选 patch 对，并借助祖先 patch 覆盖跳过重复的像素级精匹配，以减少 EPnP 前的候选并提升召回。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定预算假设排序＋谱支撑筛选＋粗到细跳算」可作为一种算力受限下证据筛选与冗余验证剪枝的线索，供核查其对 LVR 中选择视觉证据、分配动态计算的启发，但不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 状态。
